about: Photo or drawing (Nan, 2026-10-15: "Let's a/b test which does better ... based on photo v doodle"). A place listed here, with its own photograph in assets/photos/ and a doodler portrait scene, shows each browser one of the two at random (localStorage md-pd-ab-<tag>, ?ab=photo or ?ab=doodle to look without counting). Its beacons go to /api/map tagged /ab/<tag>/photo or /ab/<tag>/doodle; ab_place.py reads them.
